entries.title: Test database has a pending dispatch window migration
entries.root_cause: The test database has not applied migration 20260903114500 AddDispatchWindowToParcels. Apply the migration to the test database before running RSpec.

entries.title: RuboCop rejects a long dispatch label line
entries.root_cause: A line in the dispatch label formatter exceeds the configured Layout/LineLength limit. Reformat that expression to satisfy the style check.

entries.title: Dispatch window migration remains pending in test
entries.root_cause: The test database has not applied migration 20260903114500 AddDispatchWindowToParcels. Apply the migration to the test database before running RSpec.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later RSpec invocation loads a different spec and reports an additional pending migration, while the dispatch window migration is still unapplied.

entries.title: Dispatch label formatter still exceeds line length
entries.root_cause: A line in the dispatch label formatter exceeds the configured Layout/LineLength limit. Reformat that expression to satisfy the style check.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The formatter has moved down after unrelated edits and the later RuboCop run inspects a different set of files; the same expression still exceeds the limit.
